PUBLIC_BASE_URL is final constructor-injected deployment configuration, validated as HTTP(S) origin by EmailAccountService; it is not derived from request Host/forwarded headers and remote users cannot set it.

limitations: 0755 is not approved for secret files/directories or other chmod sites. Directory contents, build guard and package-verification flow are bound.

findings.explanation: The complete fresh flows terminate in the owner/editor username templates. Math.random contributes uniqueness to public synthetic account identifiers and the test idempotency suffix; it does not generate the fixed fixture password, server session, CSRF capability or cryptographic key. Playwright loads e2e explicitly. The application entry is /src/main.ts, tsconfig includes src only, and the final frontend image serves only Vite dist; this test module is not product runtime entropy.
limitations: The old operations test allows E2E_BASE_URL override and has no positive fixture marker check. Use the authorized isolated validation target; this finding review is not approval to run fixture accounts/passwords on arbitrary production targets.
Do not reuse Math.random for production credentials, session tokens, recovery capabilities or security entropy.

The test password is a separate fixed fixture literal; verification/reset tokens are read from real isolated Mailpit and are generated by the backend SecureRandom, not this value. The module imports Playwright and is outside the src-only application build graph. The test is skipped unless dedicated base/inbox variables exist, but that is configuration context, not proof arbitrary supplied targets are safe.
limitations: The offline browser boundary only restricts browser subresources to the selected origin; it does not authenticate that operator-selected PUBLIC_E2E_BASE_URL or TEST_MAILPIT_URL is a fixture. CI/dedicated validation configuration supplies those isolated services.
The fixed password is a test fixture and not a product credential. No claim permits this pattern for production secrets.
